mutants.name: gs27-coverage-subset

mutants.name: gs27-stream-kept-whole

mutants.name: e3b-law-repeat

mutants.rule: The worked command maps every repeated target into the domain command, in order.

mutants.name: ts-skip
mutants.rule: A ts program the leg cannot run fails; it never passes with its cases unrun.

mutants.name: ts-layout
mutants.rule: A ts/ folder and the tag ts go together.

mutants.name: ts-package
mutants.rule: A case's copy has its own package.json, so ergo-ts/bun resolves to the installed package.

mutants.name: ts-path
mutants.rule: The checkout's ergo is first on PATH for the content mapper.

mutants.name: r3b-hold-release
mutants.rule: A Hold's release runs on every exit, a stop of its caller included: a client that hangs up on the gateway stops the Ergo Hold, and its release is seen.

mutants.name: r3b-hold-wake
mutants.rule: An Advance wakes every waiting Hold, so a Hold the clock lets through is granted.

mutants.name: x2-same-origin
mutants.rule: One listener serves the RPC mount beside the page's files: /rpc reaches rpc.Answer, not http.Files.

mutants.name: x2-cancel-ended
mutants.rule: A job that has ended stays ended: a cancel of it is rejected (AlreadyDone with its state), never a second end.

mutants.name: cu3-starter-git-ignored
mutants.rule: --git makes the plan a repository, so its files end with .gitignore.

mutants.name: cu3-starter-feature-file-swapped
mutants.rule: Each feature makes its own file.

mutants.name: ert-explore-leg-case-timeout
mutants.rule: An explore search ends by itself; only -test-timeout, the safety net for a hung one, stops it, never a case's -timeout (batch 18: a healthy search failed 30 s at load 50).

mutants.name: ert-case-timeout-fixed
mutants.rule: A case is stopped only when it hangs: -timeout's default is the test legs' safety net, never a time limit that fails a slow case under load (AGENTS.md, Tests).

mutants.name: ert-budget-wall-time
mutants.rule: The default budget charges a case's CPU time, never its wall time: the host's load does not fail a healthy case (owner, 2026-11-12).

mutants.name: fk0-each-table-is-title
mutants.rule: An .each call's title is the first literal after its table, not a value of the table.

mutants.name: fk0-effect-not-a-test
mutants.rule: it.effect and it.effect.each are tests (Foldkit's Effect-vitest form).

mutants.name: fk0-test-inside-a-string
mutants.rule: A test name inside a string literal (a title that says "it (") is not a call.

mutants.name: fk0-title-not-collapsed
mutants.rule: A title across lines is one line of tests.txt, with its spaces collapsed.

mutants.name: fk0-any-file-is-upstream
mutants.rule: Only story and scene test files are restated.

mutants.name: fk0-empty-restatement
mutants.rule: Every line names its restatement, or not restated with a reason.

mutants.name: fk0-doubled-line
mutants.rule: A title has as many lines as upstream has tests of that title.

mutants.name: fk0-extra-line
mutants.rule: A line for a test upstream does not have is refused.

mutants.name: ex-neutral-ports-unchecked
mutants.rule: A port's provenance under conformance/upstream/<source>/ports/<name>/ has its tests.txt checked, and names a program.

mutants.name: ex-neutral-origin-admitted-single
mutants.rule: A program of one folder holds no origin: provenance lives under conformance/upstream, never in the example (owner, EX-NEUTRAL).

mutants.name: ex-neutral-origin-admitted-module
mutants.rule: A program of packages holds no origin: provenance lives under conformance/upstream, never in the example (owner, EX-NEUTRAL).

mutants.name: gs1-key-ergo
mutants.rule: A program's cache key holds the compiler's bytes: another bin/ergo at the same path reruns it.

mutants.name: gs1-key-env
mutants.rule: A program's cache key holds the environment the compiler and the programs read.

mutants.name: gs1-volatile-keyed
mutants.rule: A variable that changes on every invocation and that no verdict reads (systemd's INVOCATION_ID) is not keyed: with it every program missed.

mutants.name: gs1-key-file-bytes
mutants.rule: A program's cache key holds the bytes of every file of its folder.

mutants.name: gs1-record-failure
mutants.rule: Only a pass is recorded: a failed program always runs again.

mutants.name: gs1-unreadable-silent
mutants.rule: A program with no key runs, and the run says why it was not cached (fail closed, never silent).

mutants.name: gs1-ts-cached
mutants.rule: A ts program is never cached: it reads the Bun cache, which the key cannot name.
mutants.gap: The law's fixture has no ts program (the ts leg needs Bun and a warm Bun cache); the rule is a list read by programKey.

mutants.name: gateex-programs-serial
mutants.rule: The runner runs -jobs programs at once, not one at a time.

mutants.name: gateex-output-by-completion
mutants.rule: Each program's lines print in selection order, whatever order the programs end in.

mutants.name: one-module-ignores-evaluation
mutants.rule: One ergo test of a program of packages still compares each package's check-time verdicts with its part of the native report.

mutants.name: module-run-with-full-tier
mutants.rule: A module with full-tier folders tests each fast package alone: one ergo test DIR/... would run the full-tier folders too.

mutants.name: one-module-check-per-package
mutants.rule: The check legs of a program of packages are one ergo check DIR/..., one load of the module, not one per package.

mutants.name: one-module-check-misfiled
mutants.rule: Each envelope of one ergo check DIR/... is judged against its own package's part of the native report, in the order the packages ran.

mutants.name: cache-bound-examples-user-cache
mutants.rule: Every compiler call of the runner builds in the run's own emission cache, which the run removes, never the caller's or the user's.

mutants.name: ex2-no-fix-leg
mutants.rule: A program a clause ergo fix would write fails the examples step (q137).

mutants.name: examples-workload-unexpected
mutants.rule: A program of packages may hold a workload file (scripts/opcount).

mutants.name: examples-workload-unchecked

mutants.rule: A program that installs a module of the repository by a go.mod replace runs the module's package tests in its test leg.

mutants.name: gs8-driver-unkeyed
mutants.rule: Under early cutoff the key holds the driver's sources: an edit of cmd/ergo reruns every program.

mutants.name: gs8-test-emission-unkeyed
mutants.rule: Under early cutoff the key holds the Go each test target emits: a compiler that emits another test binary reruns the program.

mutants.name: gs20-key-results-dropped
mutants.rule: A missed program's fmt and check legs take the results its key's calls made; they do not run again.

mutants.name: gs8-check-unkeyed
mutants.rule: Under early cutoff the key holds each check leg's result: a compiler that checks otherwise reruns the program.

mutants.name: gs8-fmt-unkeyed
mutants.rule: Under early cutoff the key holds the fmt leg's result: a compiler that formats otherwise reruns the program.

mutants.name: gs8-bytes-keyed
mutants.rule: In a checkout with a driver, a compiler of other bytes that emits the same Go replays (early cutoff): a lower edit does not rerun every example.

mutants.name: gs8-producer-keyed
mutants.rule: A check leg is keyed without its envelope's producer, the compiler's own digest, which no leg reads: a compiler of other bytes with the same results replays.

mutants.name: gs8-snapshot-producer-keyed
mutants.rule: A check leg is keyed without its snapshot's producer either: ergo check names the compiler's digest in both places.

mutants.name: gs31b-check-not-keyed

mutants.name: examples-layout-programs-skipped

mutants.name: examples-layout-go-unclaimed

mutants.name: examples-layout-ledger-anywhere
